prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium physically based 3D product visualization for an electrical engineering academic portfolio. Output landscape 1536x1024. Studio-quality photorealistic materials, realistic physical depth and proportions, cinematic but restrained softbox lighting, rich midnight navy #08111F background, subtle cyan edge illumination, silvery metal, dark engineering surfaces, soft contact shadows. Sophisticated engineering editorial art direction. No people, no floating icons, no cartoon geometry, no logos, no watermarks, no decorative text. This is a concept render, not evidence of an actual personal project or validated circuit. Do not include readable pinout diagrams, numerical readings, graphs, measurement claims or labels suggesting a tested working installation. Subject: one cohesive isometric research-scale energy installation on a machined dark plinth. A detailed 3-by-4 solar photovoltaic canopy with visible fine cells, metallic frames, support columns and busbar texture at rear left; a refined silver modern electric crossover in front right, realistic wheel spokes, windows, door seams and proportions, connected via a physically plausible thick black charging cable to a tall navy EV charger with small blank dark screen. A compact brushed-aluminum power conversion cabinet with ventilation fins sits adjacent. At foreground left a realistic small green embedded-controller PCB under a clear protective enclosure with chips, connectors and fine copper traces, connected conceptually via one restrained cyan light line embedded in the plinth. No fantasy flying objects. Three-quarter elevated camera, entire installation fills the frame; generous breathing room around the subject. Render every component with high manufacturing detail; premium automotive/product photography feel, not a miniature toy. Composition balanced for a large website hero right column, no text.
